dict.string: Arova requires microphone access for voice queries, wake word detection, and ambient audio interaction.
Arova uses speech recognition to convert voice commands into cognitive actions.
Arova requires permission to automate and interact with editors, browsers, and terminal applications on your Mac.
Arova requires access to your Desktop folder to index and restore active project files.
Arova requires access to your Documents folder to index and restore active workspace files.
Arova requires access to your Downloads folder to locate downloaded reference materials.
Arova requires accessibility access to detect active windows, support global shortcuts, and focus restored applications.
